```{=html}
<div class="hyp-anim" id="hypAnim">
  <style>
    .hyp-anim {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, sans-serif;
    border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 1rem 1rem .75rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 1.6rem;
    }

    .hyp-anim .panes {
        display: flex;
        gap: .8rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .hyp-anim .pane {
        text-align: center;
    }

    .hyp-anim canvas {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
    }

    .hyp-anim .pane h4 {
        margin: .2rem 0 .1rem;
        font-size: .85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
    }

    .hyp-anim .count {
        font-size: .8rem;
        color: var(--muted, #666);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        min-height: 1.2em;
    }

    .hyp-anim .count b {
        color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
    }

    .hyp-anim .ctrl {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: .6rem;
        margin-top: .6rem;
        font-size: .8rem;
        color: var(--muted, #666);
    }

    .hyp-anim input[type=range] {
        flex: 1;
        accent-color: var(--accent, #8a4b2a);
    }

    .hyp-anim button {
        font: inherit;
        color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
        background: none;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
        border-radius: 4px;
        padding: .15rem .6rem;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .anim-note {
        font-size: .9rem;
    }
  </style>
 
  <div class="panes">
    <div class="pane">
      <h4>Euclidean plane</h4>
      <canvas id="hypEu" width="560" height="560" style="width:230px"></canvas>
      <div class="count" id="hypEuCount"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pane">
      <h4>Hyperbolic plane (Poincar&eacute; disk)</h4>
      <canvas id="hypHy" width="560" height="560" style="width:230px"></canvas>
      <div class="count" id="hypHyCount"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ctrl">
    <button id="hypPlay" aria-label="play or pause">&#9654;</button>
    <span>radius&nbsp;r</span>
    <input type="range" id="hypR" min="0.5" max="6" step="0.02" value="2"
           aria-label="hyperbolic radius r">
    <span id="hypRVal" style="min-width:2.5em; text-align:right">2.00</span>
  </div>
 
  <script>
    (function () {
      var SPACING = 0.4, RMAX = 6;
      var eu = document.getElementById("hypEu"), hy = document.getElementById("hypHy");
      var euCount = document.getElementById("hypEuCount"),
          hyCount = document.getElementById("hypHyCount");
      var slider = document.getElementById("hypR"),
          rVal = document.getElementById("hypRVal"),
          play = document.getElementById("hypPlay");

      function colors() {
          var cs = getComputedStyle(document.body);
          var get = function (name, fb) {
              var v = cs.getPropertyValue(name).trim(); return v || fb;
          };
          return {
              fg: get("--fg", "#1a1a1a"), muted: get("--muted", "#666"),
              rule: get("--rule", "#e2e2e2"), accent: get("--accent", "#8a4b2a")
          };
      }

      function drawPane(canvas, r, toEuclid, boundary) {
          var c = colors(), ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
          var W = canvas.width, cx = W / 2, R = W / 2 - 8;
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;

          if (boundary) {
              ctx.strokeStyle = c.fg; ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(cx, cx, R, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.strokeStyle = c.rule;
          for (var k = 1; k <= RMAX; k++) {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cx, toEuclid(k) * R, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
          }
          var rr = toEuclid(r) * R;
          ctx.strokeStyle = c.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cx, rr, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
          return { ctx: ctx, cx: cx, rr: rr, accent: c.accent };
      }

      function dots(p, n) {
          p.ctx.fillStyle = p.accent;
          var size = n > 900 ? 1.6 : (n > 300 ? 2.4 : 3.5);
          for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
              var a = 2 * Math.PI * i / n;
              p.ctx.beginPath();
              p.ctx.arc(p.cx + p.rr * Math.cos(a), p.cx + p.rr * Math.sin(a), size, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
              p.ctx.fill();
          }
      }

      function render() {
          var r = parseFloat(slider.value);
          rVal.textContent = r.toFixed(2);
          var nE = Math.max(1, Math.round(2 * Math.PI * r / SPACING));
          var nH = Math.max(1, Math.round(2 * Math.PI * Math.sinh(r) / SPACING));
          var pE = drawPane(eu, r, function (x) { return x / RMAX; }, false);
          var pH = drawPane(hy, r, function (x) { return Math.tanh(x / 2); }, true);
          dots(pE, nE); dots(pH, nH);
          euCount.innerHTML = "circumference 2&pi;r ;&nbsp; <b>" + nE + "</b> points";
          hyCount.innerHTML = "circumference 2&pi;&middot;sinh&thinsp;r ;&nbsp; <b>" + nH + "</b> points";
      }

      var timer = null;
      play.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; play.innerHTML = "&#9654;"; return; }
          play.innerHTML = "&#10074;&#10074;";
          timer = setInterval(function () {
              var r = parseFloat(slider.value) + 0.02;
              if (r > RMAX) r = 0.5;
              slider.value = r; render();
          }, 40);
      });
      slider.addEventListener("input", render);
      if (window.matchMedia)
          window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", render);
      render();
    })();
  </script>
</div>
```
